#!/bin/bash
python3 - /run/bench61055917/containerd/containerd.sock "$1" <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
import sys

sock, out = sys.argv[1:3]


def ctr(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["sudo", "ctr", "-a", sock, *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


containers, images = [], []
for ns in ctr("namespaces", "ls", "-q").split():            # every namespace, not only k8s.io
    digest = {}
    for line in ctr("-n", ns, "images", "ls").splitlines()[1:]:
        ref, _type, dg = line.split()[:3]
        digest[ref] = dg
        images.append({"ref": ref, "digest": dg})            # the sha256:... aliases of the CRI plugin are listed too
    pid = {}
    for line in ctr("-n", ns, "tasks", "ls").splitlines()[1:]:
        f = line.split()
        pid[f[0]] = int(f[1])
    for line in ctr("-n", ns, "containers", "ls").splitlines()[1:]:
        cid, image = line.split()[:2]
        containers.append({"id": cid, "image": image, "digest": digest[image], "pid": pid.get(cid)})
json.dump({"containers": containers, "images": images}, open(out, "w"))
